{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Launch SDGD-zero on MAVEN: full three-arm comparison
# Expected runtime: ~3-4 GPU hours on single RTX PRO 6000
# Do NOT run while exp_docred_bcs_expanded is on GPU

set -euo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1

cd /root/schema-dag-extraction/src

OUTPUT_DIR="/root/schema-dag-extraction/artifacts/exp_sdgd_zero_maven"
LOG_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/full_run.log"

mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

echo "[$(date)] Starting SDGD-zero MAVEN experiment" | tee "${LOG_FILE}"
echo "[$(date)] Output: ${OUTPUT_DIR}" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"

/root/miniconda3/bin/python run_sdgd_maven.py \
    --max_samples 1000 \
    --max_model_len 4096 \
    --k 1.0 \
    --seed 42 \
    --random_seeds 42 43 44 \
    --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
    2>&1 | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"

echo "[$(date)] Experiment complete" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
